title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company's journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

Nossa atuação é dividida em três frentes especializadas: Welcome Weddings, setor especializado em Destination Wedding, com assessoria completa e personalizada desde a da produção do casamento até a viagem. A Welcome Trips que é o setor especializado em viagens de lazer, onde a personalização e a excelência são a essência de cada roteiro, e Welcome Corp, focada em viagens corporativas e de incentivo.

A Welcome Weddings é reconhecida internacionalmente como a melhor produtora de Destination Wedding da América Latina. Mais do que realizar casamentos, nossa missão é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Os setores de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos são responsáveis por conceber, organizar e coordenar todos os detalhes de um Destination Wedding, desde a escolha do destino e do local ideais até a execução impecável de cada evento. A equipe compreende profundamente o perfil e os desejos do casal, orienta nas decisões mais adequadas, realiza a reserva da data, o bloqueio de apartamentos no hotel definido e estrutura toda a programação dos eventos. Além disso, conecta o casal aos profissionais ideais e garante que cada elemento reflita sua visão, proporcionando uma experiência única, personalizada e memorável.

Sua missão:

Sua missão será liderar, integrar e garantir a excelência de todo o processo do Destination Wedding, atuando da concepção à entrega final para garantir o propósito da Welcome Weddings que é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a operação completa dos eventos;
  • Liderar e orientar as equipes;
  • Supervisionar a escolha dos destinos e locais;
  • Acompanhar e validar reservas e bloqueios;
  • Garantir a estruturação da programação dos eventos;
  • Assegurar a personalização e a qualidade da entrega;
  • Monitorar a experiência do casal do início ao fim.

Suas principais atividades:

Acompanhar a jornada de cada casal com base nos processos de Planejamento e Produção, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade e personalização em todas as etapas. Estruturar, aprimorar e monitorar continuamente os processos de Planejamento e Produção junto à Wedding Planner responsável por cada projeto. Apoiar as demandas operacionais dos departamentos, definindo a Wedding Planner responsável por cada casal em cada fase do processo. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas semanais com os departamentos, promovendo alinhamento e tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e capacitar os times, apoiando o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) de cada colaborador. Atuar como elo entre coordenadores e diretoria, assegurando comunicação clara e estratégica. Prevenir e gerenciar situações de crise, garantindo soluções rápidas, eficazes e alinhadas aos valores da empresa. Acompanhar metas e indicadores de desempenho de cada setor, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa organizada, proativa e com atenção aos detalhes para atuar de forma integrada nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal e Facilities, apoiando a jornada do colaborador e garantindo a eficiência dos processos administrativos e operacionais do escritório.

  • Dar suporte aos processos de Recrutamento e Seleção, acompanhando vagas, agendas e comunicações com candidatos.

  • Experiência prévia de 1 a 2 anos em áreas de RH, People Operations, Payroll, Facilities.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. title: Analista de contas a receber pleno
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

Como é atuar conosco

Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar emissão e envio de boletos;
  • Executar rotinas de conciliação, contas a receber e abatimento de notas;

O que esperamos de você

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul, localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil), ampliando sua presença no mercado global.

Estamos a procura de Projetistas de Produto Pleno e Sênior.

Áreas:

  • Body in White;
  • Closures;
  • Internal Trims;
  • External Trims;

  • 5 anos ou mais de experiência como projetista de desenvolvimento de produto nas áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de peças plásticas;
  • Conhecimento e domínio dos softwares CATIA V5 ou Unigraphics NX (testes poderão ser aplicados durante o processo);

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team's evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You'll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business: Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset: Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem: Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit: You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our "Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analista de Redes Sênior
description:
¡En @Ayesa crecemos juntos!

Cada profissional da nossa empresa é importante para nós, nos ajudam a crescer de maneira diversa e, graças a eles, somos mais de 13.500 pessoas trabalhando com o mesmo objetivo em mais de 40 países. Formação superior completa em Redes de Computadores, Administração de Redes, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência superior a 5 anos em redes corporativas, com no mínimo 2 anos de atuação em Cisco ACI e Cisco ISE.

Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura e operação de SDN com Cisco ACI, incluindo tenants, EPGs, contracts, L3Out e microsegmentação.

Conhecimentos em SD-WAN, QoS, NAT e DMZ.

Experiência com monitoramento e operação utilizando Cisco DNA Center.

Capacidade de realizar troubleshooting nível N3 em ambientes críticos.

Certificações CCNA, CCNP Enterprise ou CCNP Data Center e Cisco ISE Specialist.

Projetar, implantar e manter políticas de rede utilizando Cisco ACI e Cisco ISE.

Configurar, administrar e otimizar controladores WLC para ambientes de alta densidade e segurança.

Realizar troubleshooting avançado em ambientes SDN, autenticação e conectividade.

Elaborar relatórios de performance, incidentes e conformidade.

Participar de projetos de migração, automação e integração com soluções de segurança.

Garantir alta disponibilidade dos serviços de rede e aderência aos SLAs estabelecidos.

Auxílio HomeOffice

Vale alimentação/refeição

Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família

Bday Off: Uma folga para celebrar o seu aniversário

Curso de Espanhol para impulsionar seu crescimento pessoal e profissional

Oportunidade de integrar uma empresa global em constante crescimento, com projetos inovadores em mais de 40 países

Junte-se à multinacional espanhola referência em tecnologia no mundo!

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for "SAP ABAP Odata" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP's development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

#Buildingonbelief

description:
Descrição da vaga

Ei, que bom te ver por aqui!

Você já conhece a ZAMP (Burger King / Popeyes / Starbucks / Subway)?

A ZAMP é mais do que uma operadora de restaurantes, nós somos uma comunidade que celebra a diversidade e a autenticidade. Nossas marcas globalmente reconhecidas são sinônimo de sabor e descoberta. Com mais de 1000 restaurantes espalhados pelo Brasil e uma equipe de 15 mil colaboradores, nosso sonho é ser a melhor operadora de marcas de restaurantes do mundo.

Inclusão é o nosso ingrediente secreto: Na ZAMP, valorizamos cada indivíduo e promovemos uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, portanto, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência e talentos de todas as esferas sociais.

Junte-se a nós nessa jornada, onde cada momento é uma celebração e cada desafio é uma oportunidade para transformar positivamente a vida das pessoas. Vamos juntos fazer o que é certo e construir um futuro onde todos têm lugar à mesa!

  • Atualizar manuais de atividades;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e na correção de divergências e pendências de lançamento;
  • Apoiar na implantação de projetos e melhorias em geral;
  • Apoiar na atualização de indicadores;
  • Interagir com stakeholders.

  • Experiência com Recebimento Fiscal (Notas Fiscais de Serviços e Materiais e preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte) e com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente SAP;
  • Habilidades em ferramentas do pacote office, preferencialmente Excel (VBA/macros).

• Flex Office;

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer

Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.

Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.

Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

  • PMO for Implementation: Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement: Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management: Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.

What We Need From You

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience: Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen: Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills: Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management: Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design: Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership: A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil's key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.

You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil's engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America's most dynamic markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
  • Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (LinkedIn, sector-specific networks).
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
  • Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients' engineering challenges.
  • Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
  • Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
  • Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.).
  • Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1M).
  • Strong existing network in Brazil's engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
  • Proficiency in CRM tools
  • Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
  • Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Tráfego - CallCenter
description:
Coordenador de Planejamento e Tráfego

Para o match perfeito acontecer precisa de PESSOAS, com as mais diversas experiências e pontos de vista, para que possamos continuar evoluindo enquanto empresa.

Por isso, aqui na SulAmérica, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todas as raças/etnias, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero, gerações, com ou sem deficiência, para todas as nossas vagas. Afinal, as nossas diferenças é o que nos complementam!

#LGBTI+ #PessoasNegras #PcD #50+ #Gerações #PessoasComDeficiência

Como será o seu dia a dia nessa área:

O Coordenador de Planejamento e Tráfego é garantir o equilíbrio matemático entre a demanda de clientes e a força de trabalho, assegurando que os níveis de serviço (SLA) sejam atingidos com a máxima eficiência operacional. O foco está em prever o futuro (forecast) e orquestrar o presente (real-time) para que nenhum cliente fique sem atendimento e nenhum recurso humano seja desperdiçado.

Principais Responsabilidades:

● Coordenar equipe para garantir realização do forecast de chamadas e mapeamento de tráfego e das plataformas de atendimento (Atendimento receptivo e ativo, WhatsApp, Chat, E-mail, Backoffice e Bot) quanto à volumetria, curvas diárias e intrahora, SLA e outras informações pertinentes ao atendimento;

● Gerar de forma detalhada estudo do dimensionamento e análise de forecast x capacity para curto, médio e longo prazo sugerindo mudanças quando necessário e acompanhar essas informações na rotina;

● Controlar diariamente os indicadores operacionais de tráfego (Intraday) e demanda da operação (planejado x real), sinalizando possíveis desvios e propor correções;

● Acompanhamento do orçamento da área e elaboração de estudos focados na otimização e redução de custos Budget (Real x planejado) e identificação de oportunidades e melhores práticas;

● Forecast (curto, médio e longo prazo);

● Capacity planning;

● Real-time management;

● Dimensionamento de equipes;

● Elaboração e controle de escalas;

● Análise de SLA, TMA, Nível de Serviço e outros indicadores operacionais.

Requisitos necessários para ser Consultor de Projetos e Processos na #Sula:

● Experiência em liderança de equipes;

● Capacidade de desenvolver e capacitar o time, promovendo crescimento técnico e comportamental;

● Alinhamento constante entre as áreas afim de garantir coerência entre planejamento e execução;

● Participação em projetos estratégicos e implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos de planejamento;

● Responsável por garantir a acuracidade do forecast e assertividade dos dimensionamentos;

● Acompanhamento e gestão de KPIs operacionais e de produtividade (NS, TMA, Ocupação, Aderência, etc.);

● Capacidade de apresentar resultados em reuniões executivas, defendendo decisões com base em dados.

Modalidade: Presencial

Local de trabalho: Barra funda

Contratação: CLT

O que você precisa para ser #SangueLaranja?

Buscamos pessoas que gostem de desafios e:

Sejam colaborativas;

Tenham foco no resultado e centralidade em nossos(as) clientes;

Saibam se adaptar aos diferentes desafios do dia a dia;

Que tenha sempre em mente o inconformismo, propondo soluções inovadoras.

O que oferecemos para você:

Salário competitivo com o mercado.

Vale Refeição e Alimentação.

Assistência Médica e Odontológica (extensiva a dependentes) da SulAmérica!

Seguro de vida SulAmérica.

Auxílio Creche /Babá.

Programa de Participação nos Resultados.

Vale transporte.

Se identificou? Então, vem fazer parte do time #SangueLaranja

Sobre nós:

Há mais de 129 anos, a SulAmérica tem como missão melhorar a vida das pessoas, oferecendo apoio, segurança e autonomia em todos os momentos. Atendemos 6.8 milhões de clientes por meio de nossos produtos e serviços de Saúde, Odonto, Vida, Previdência e Investimentos. Para tornar isso possível, contamos com o engajamento e a dedicação de mais de 4 mil colaboradores(as) comprometidos(as) com o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos que por meio da inclusão e da diversidade construímos um ambiente seguro e de pertencimento que valoriza e respeita as pessoas integralmente. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, de diferentes raças e etnias, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e gerações para todas as nossas vagas.

Quer saber mais sobre nós?

Acompanhe a gente aqui no LinkedIn e no Instagram: @sulamerica

A SulAmerica informa que todas as oportunidades de emprego são divulgadas exclusivamente através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Adicionalmente, todo o processo de comunicação com os candidatos é conduzido unicamente por meio de endereços de e-mail que possuem o domínio @sulamerica.com.br.

Para visualizar as vagas disponíveis, acessem nosso perfil institucional no LinkedIn. Alertamos que qualquer comunicação recebida de outras fontes ou domínios deve ser desconsiderada imediatamente.

title: Analista de RH
description:
Missão do Cargo

Atuar como parceiro estratégico do negócio, conectando a estratégia organizacional às práticas de gestão de pessoas da Aegea, garantindo execução com excelência dos processos e subsistemas corporativos, atuação orientada por dados e alavancagem dos resultados do negócio por meio de pessoas, com responsabilidade sobre a governança de remuneração.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como consultor interno das lideranças, apoiando decisões de gestão de pessoas, cultura, clima, desempenho, desenvolvimento, organização do trabalho e estrutura organizacional.
  • Traduzir a estratégia do negócio em ações de RH, assegurando alinhamento entre objetivos organizacionais, práticas de pessoas e resultados.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de gestão de pessoas, garantindo coerência, qualidade e padronização nos processos de atração, integração, desempenho, desenvolvimento, capacitação de lideranças e operacionais, engajamento, movimentações, reconhecimento, sucessão e desligamentos.
  • Atuar com forte interface junto aos processos e subsistemas corporativos de Gestão de Pessoas da Aegea, garantindo aderência, consistência e execução com excelência no nível local.
  • Atuar como guardião dos processos de remuneração, assegurando a correta aplicação das políticas corporativas de salários, estruturas de cargos, movimentações salariais, mérito, promoções e incentivos, em conformidade com diretrizes internas e legislação vigente.
  • Garantir a governança dos processos de remuneração, assegurando critérios claros, registros adequados, controles, prazos e comunicação correta com líderes e áreas especialistas.
  • Realizar atendimentos a líderes e colaboradores, orientando sobre políticas de remuneração, carreira e demais práticas de RH, e direcionando tratativas para áreas especialistas quando necessário.
  • Atuar no planejamento, organização e apoio à execução de capacitações, treinamentos e trilhas de desenvolvimento para lideranças e públicos operacionais, em parceria com educação interna.
  • Conduzir sua atuação com base em People Analytics, utilizando dados e indicadores de pessoas e remuneração para diagnósticos, análises comparativas e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Atuar na administração e controle de jornada de trabalho, acompanhando apontamentos, exceções, absenteísmo e horas extras.
  • Organizar, participar e conduzir rituais de reporte de resultados e indicadores de gestão de pessoas, garantindo análise crítica, clareza e direcionamento para ação.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de RH e remuneração (turnover, absenteísmo, jornada, SLA de R&S, engajamento, performance, custo de pessoal), realizando análises de causa raiz.
  • Realizar análise de falhas e desvios nos processos e indicadores de pessoas e remuneração, propondo soluções estruturais e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Propor, nortear e acompanhar planos de ação focados em pessoas, com foco em eficiência, equidade interna, competitividade externa e alavancagem dos resultados do negócio.
  • Garantir a execução disciplinada dos processos e políticas corporativas de RH, com alto padrão de governança, pontualidade, qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Conduzir conversas assertivas, negociações e alinhamentos com líderes e stakeholders, influenciando decisões e comportamentos.
  • Atuar em projetos e iniciativas estratégicas de RH, em parceria com áreas especialistas, educação interna e times corporativos.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e sistêmica de RH
  • Forte orientação a dados e decisões baseadas em evidências
  • Comunicação assertiva e escuta ativa
  • Habilidade relacional para trabalhar em equipe e habilidade de negociação
  • Disciplina, organização e rigor em governança
  • Senso de responsabilidade e accountability
  • Capacidade analítica, crítica e de solução de problemas
  • Compromisso com equidade, ética e melhoria contínua

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de grande porte ou estruturas corporativas complexas.
  • Vivência em modelos estruturados de remuneração e governança corporativa.
  • Atuação em projetos de transformação organizacional ou eficiência operacional.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.

We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Solution Engineer to join our São Paulo office.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Network Planning and Deployment:

- Participate in the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of the company's network architecture, ensuring stability, security, and scalability.

- Responsible for the deployment and configuration of data center environments, corporate networks, and cloud networks (public/private).

- Responsible for assessing network requirements, designing solutions, and implementing new business systems.

2. Daily Operations and Monitoring:

- Responsible for daily monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response across the company's entire network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, wireless networks, etc.).

- Develop and execute network change processes, ensuring standardized operations with controlled risks.

- Prepare operational documentation, technical proposals, and incident reports.

3. Performance and Security Management:

- Continuously monitor network performance, analyze traffic data, and perform capacity planning and performance tuning.

- Responsible for configuring and managing network security policies, including firewall rules, access control lists (ACLs), intrusion detection/prevention, etc.

- Collaborate with the security team on network audits, vulnerability scans, and hardening activities.

4. Technical Support and Collaboration:

- Provide network-level technical support to other internal teams (e.g., systems, application development, business departments).

- Communicate and coordinate with vendors and service providers to resolve issues related to circuits and equipment.

Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or related fields.

- Fluent English.

- Proficiency in the TCP/IP protocol stack, in-depth understanding of the OSI model, and routing and switching principles (e.g., STP, OSPF, BGP, VRRP).

- Proven ability to configure, manage, and troubleshoot network equipment from leading vendors (e.g., Cisco, Huawei, H3C, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet).

Specific Technologies (Knowledge in):

- Security: Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), WAF, and security policies.

- Wireless: Knowledge of corporate wireless network planning (e.g., Aruba, Cisco) and troubleshooting.- Load Balancing: Knowledge of configuring devices such as F5, Citrix NetScaler, and Nginx.

- Data Center: Knowledge of architectures such as VXLAN, EVPN, and Spine-Leaf.

Automation and Operations Capabilities:

- Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios).

- Basic programming/scripting skills (e.g., Python, Ansible) for configuration automation, batch operations, and tool development are a plus.

- Knowledge of version control tools such as Git.

Preferred Requirements:

- Certifications: CCNA / HCIA /CCNP / HCIP / CCIE (RS/Security)

- Advanced Chinese (Mandarin) proficiency

Work Model:

This is an on-site position based in São Paulo, with the possibility of occasional business travel.

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.

Detailed Description

Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).

Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.

Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.

Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.

Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.

Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.

Qualification Minimum Requirements

Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage

Educational:

Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English

Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)

Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:
Key Responsibilities:

Oversee day-to-day operations of multiple e-commerce platforms, ensuring accuracy in inventory, smooth order fulfillment, and efficient payment processing. Lead coordination across marketing, sales, logistics, and customer service teams to execute online campaigns, promotions, and seasonal events. Maintain and continuously optimize product listings, content, and digital assets to align with brand goals and drive conversion. Monitor stock movements across digital channels, implement replenishment alerts, and reduce risks of stockouts or overstock. Develop operational SOPs to scale post-purchase processes and maximize efficiency. Track and report on key operational metrics: order accuracy, return rates, customer satisfaction, and service SLAs. Proactively manage escalations related to payment issues, delivery discrepancies, or customer feedback. Identify workflow bottlenecks and apply process automation tools where possible. Partner with regional teams to ensure local compliance, payment reconciliation, and logistics alignment.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Logistics, or related field. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in e-commerce operations or retail fulfillment; preferably in mobile tech, consumer electronics, or FMCG. Professional fluency in English (mandatory); additional languages are a plus Demonstrated ability to lead operational initiatives and drive performance improvements across teams. High attention to detail and familiarity with supply chain and payment systems. Strong analytical mindset and experience interpreting operational data and customer insights. Passion for innovation, digital commerce, and emerging tech markets

description:

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Linux Júnior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Responsabilidades e atividades

  • Atuar no suporte, administração e operação de ambientes em Kubernetes e Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS), seguindo arquiteturas e padrões já definidos pelo time.
  • Apoiar o deploy de soluções em containers e a orquestração de aplicações, com acompanhamento técnico.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com a equipe de Desenvolvimento para apoiar melhorias no ambiente e resolução de incidentes de baixa e média complexidade.
  • Auxiliar na administração de ambientes Linux, incluindo atividades relacionadas a sistema operacional, redes, VPN e segurança, conforme diretrizes estabelecidas.
  • Apoiar a configuração e manutenção de monitoramento, alertas e coleta de logs das aplicações e serviços utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus e Grafana.
  • Atuar na execução e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD já existentes, utilizando ferramentas como GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins.
  • Apoiar processos de deploy baseados em GitOps utilizando ArgoCD, seguindo práticas e fluxos definidos pelo time.
  • Contribuir para a documentação técnica da infraestrutura, seguindo desenhos e arquiteturas já estabelecidas.
  • Participar ativamente das rotinas do time, compartilhando aprendizados e absorvendo boas práticas para evolução técnica contínua.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática entre 2 anos e meio e 3 anos em atividades relacionadas a DevOps, SRE, infraestrutura ou cloud.
  • Experiência com orquestradores de containers como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou similares.
  • Vivência em pelo menos uma nuvem pública, como AWS, GCP ou, preferencialmente, Azure.
  • Conhecimento dos princípios da cultura DevOps e SRE.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com monitoramento de aplicações, infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Datadog ou New Relic.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD como GitLab, GitHub Actions ou Jenkins.
  • Noções de deploy utilizando GitOps com ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais Linux, tanto em máquinas virtuais quanto em containers.
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias.

title: Analista de Confiabilidade Analítica

Supervisionar e controlar a execução das atividades, dos planos de ações e dos processos estabelecidos por uma coordenação ou pelo nível gerencial.

Supervisionar atividades e equipes em sua área de atuação, sendo responsável pelo planejamento operacional e pelos resultados obtidos.

Acompanhar e elaborar relatórios periódicos de tendência de investimentos.

Avaliar impactos na contabilidade em função dos valores de tendência, através de simulador de impactos de resultado.

Supervisionar o acompanhamento e alimentação de plano de ação das principais obras.

Participar da elaboração do planejamento periódico, fornecendo informações sobre a tendência de investimentos.

Supervisionar o acompanhamento e controle de prazos de meio ambiente, desapropriação e elaboração de projetos para execução da obra.

Supervisionar o fornecimento de insumos.

Supervisionar as ações relativas ao andamento de contratos.

Supervisionar a equipe de planejamento, distribuindo tarefas, orientando membros juniores e plenos, e garantindo que as atividades estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do projeto.

Colaborar na elaboração de estratégias e planos de execução do projeto, incluindo cronogramas, alocação de recursos, análise de riscos e estratégias de contingência.

Acompanhar de perto o andamento do projeto, analisando relatórios de progresso, identificando desvios do cronograma ou orçamento e implementando ações corretivas quando necessário.

Oferecer suporte técnico à equipe, solucionando problemas complexos, revisando documentação técnica e garantindo a conformidade com normas e regulamentos.

Manter comunicação eficaz com diversas equipes, stakeholders e departamentos envolvidos no projeto, assegurando alinhamento e resolução de questões.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de planejamento e execução, buscando aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos.

Assegurar que os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos sejam cumpridos durante todas as fases do projeto, garantindo a conformidade com especificações técnicas e regulamentos.

Realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho da equipe, fornecendo feedback e identificando áreas de desenvolvimento para o aprimoramento profissional.

Supervisionar as medições, verificando e aprovando prazos e quantidades.

Participar de projetos e programas da empresa, contribuindo com ideias e sugestões para a melhoria dos processos.

Seguir as normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.

Desejável conhecimento em Autocad, MSproject, Primavera P6 e Pacote Office

Desejável experiência no segmento da construção civil

Disponibilidade para trabalhar na Zona Norte/SP

title: MCA IV&V Engineer
description:
Descrição do emprego

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Contagem, Minas Gerais.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of Modular Control Architecture (MCA) software team. The MCA SW architecture is highly flexible, made up of many modular software, application, and hardware elements. While flexibility adds opportunity and capability, it also adds complexity, driving the importance of a robust platform SW and communication strategy. MCA is built on MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) principles for requirements management and test cases with full traceability built into the MBSE model.

How will you make a difference?

The "MCA Controls Test Engineer" is responsible for development and maintenance of test plans and procedures to execute the testing on HITL & locomotive environments. This role includes reviewing and analysis of design requirements, functional specifications and creating test plans and test procedures.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation engineering with a broad technical understanding of IV&V activities.
  • Strong knowledge of related design/test engineering experience with hands on experience on testing and validation utilizing the following platforms: HITL, SITL, system level (preferable Locomotive or Automotive).
  • Experience in developing test procedures for control software, electrical and electronic equipment, systems, and components.
  • Strong understanding of general control design principles including various communication protocols (Serial RS232/422, CAN or ethernet).
  • Ability to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives.
  • Ability to travel (domestic and overseas) as required (travel

What will your typical day look like?

  • Participate in design/system requirements review, specification reviews at various levels within the system/sub-system.
  • Development of test procedure on Magic Draw/Doors to perform system integration testing and system level testing.
  • Provide inputs for creating test environment/setup, review & maintain test results.
  • Execution of test procedures on control software and components utilizing the following platforms: Hardware in the loop (HITL), Model in the loop (MITL), Locomotive.
  • Create a record of all deviations/defects with enough details using formal software life cycle management tools (Clear Quest etc.) & provide support until resolution.
  • Develop automation scripts to automate test procedures, data collection, generate reports and ensure repeatable measurements with the help of test tools and simulators.
  • Perform system-level testing on HITL/Locomotive against the system requirement and interface specification prior to production release.
  • Working closely with the internal and external design/test teams in identifying problems & implementing solutions.
  • Produce periodic status and operational reports
  • Apply and improve the utilization of all software and hardware tools and assist in the creation of new testing software, hardware tools and techniques.
  • Make independent technical contributions in support of program objectives, as well as interacting with other Wabtec or contract engineers.

Benefícios:

Na Wabtec, pessoas estão em primeiro lugar. Por isso, cuidamos para que nossos funcionários se sintam valorizados e tenham as ferramentas necessárias para prosperar. Ao se juntar a nós, você terá acesso a uma série de benefícios pensados para promover seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Confira o que oferecemos para que você se sinta parte de uma empresa que apoia sua jornada profissional e pessoal:

  • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos)

  • Programa para Gestantes e Bebês
  • Política de incentivo a idiomas
  • Programas de Mentoria e acesso a plataforma de treinamento

Informações Adicionais

Na Wabtec, não se trata apenas de um emprego — é sobre o impacto que você gera. Quando nossas pessoas se unem, Expandimos o Possível,melhorando constantemente o que fazemos e como fazemos — para nossos clientes e para uns aos outros.

title: Senior Logistics Specialist-First Mile
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from a global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on-demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry.

To learn more about SHEIN, visit

Key Responsibilities

● First Mile Operations Management: Oversee first mile logistics, including seller pickups and drop-off point dispatching with partner carriers. Monitor daily operations, ensuring adherence to timelines and cost targets. Proactively follow up on performance, investigate anomalies, and implement corrective actions to prevent operational disruptions.

● Performance Management: Define and track KPIs to measure operational efficiency. Develop dashboards and reports to monitor performance, providing data-driven insights to internal stakeholders and senior management.

● Supplier Coordination: Manage relationships with logistics partners, ensuring service levels meet company standards. Conduct regular meetings, communicate volume forecasts, and align expectations for short- and medium-term operations.

● Operational Standardization: Establish and document best practices for first mile logistics. Define roles, responsibilities, and performance management models to ensure consistency and efficiency across operations.

● Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements in logistics operations and supplier performance. Benchmark industry best practices and develop initiatives to enhance efficiency, capacity, and cost-effectiveness.

● Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Lead proactive issue resolution, ensuring smooth communication between teams and timely escalation of critical cases. Implement feedback loops to drive continuous operational improvements.

● Strategic Network Planning: Support the development of first mile network strategies, aligning logistics infrastructure with business growth plans and cost optimization goals.

Requirements

● Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.

● Minimum of 5 years in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce and/or express logistics.

● Operational Expertise: Strong understanding of first mile logistics, supplier coordination, and performance management.

● Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to analyze KPIs, identify risks, and drive process improvements through data insights.

● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to visit field operations, engage with sellers, and ensure seamless execution.

● Problem-Solving Skills: Quick analytical thinking to address operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

● Project Management: Experience in leading and executing logistics projects, working cross-functionally to achieve business goals.

● Mandatory fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish and Mandarin are plus.

-CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Analyst - Documentation
description:
Job Title: Analyst – Documentation

Department: Customer Service & Documentation

Reporting To: Manager – Customer Service and Documentation

Direct Reports: N/A

Job Purpose

The Documentation Analyst is responsible for the efficient handling import/export documentation, ensuring compliance with Brazilian Federal Revenue (RFB) regulations, supporting customers with document requirements, maintaining system integrity, and coordinating with ports, terminals, carriers, and stakeholders. The role ensures timely submissions, documentation accuracy, and professional interactions to support seamless cargo handling.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Customer Service & Documentation Handling

• Ensure shipping documentation accuracy including BL issuance, corrections, and approvals

• Respond to customer requests regarding BL, arrival, clearance, cargo information, and deadlines

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Maintain communication with vessels, carriers, terminals, and agents

Regulatory Compliance & System Processing

• Update Carrier systems and internal agency systems

• Ensure BL updates, approvals, and registry details follow Carrier process and Brazilian Regulations as per RFB IN 800 deadlines

• Maintain correct data in Siscomex Carga, safeguarding the interest of the agency and carriers

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Assist with process of cargo authorization and release document validation

Confidentiality & Compliance

• Ensure confidentiality of customer and company data

• Follow code of ethics, compliance, and data protection protocols

• Maintain audit-ready documentation standards

Team & Departmental Support

• Assist the Manager as required

• Maintain collaborative relationships with colleagues, service providers, and customers

• Promote a professional, efficient, and cooperative working environment

Key Interactions

Internal: Operations, Finance, Commercial

External: Customers, Agents, Carriers, Terminal Operators, Port Authorities

Core Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Integrity & Accountability - Ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance in documentation activities

• Customer Focus – Provides reliable service and support to internal and external customers

• Continuous Learning – Understands documentation regulations and system updates

• Agility – Manages multiple shipments, deadlines, and last-minute changes effectively

• Collaboration & Communication – Works effectively with various stakeholders

Functional Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of Brazilian customs requirements and manifest process

• Data Accuracy & Quality Control – Maintains high data integrity and timely document handling

• Customer Service Orientation – Maintains customer satisfaction through professional service

• ERP/Data System Proficiency – Uses digital systems for data entry and process control

Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Logistics, or related field

Experience:

• Minimum 2 years' experience in documentation, shipping, or port regulatory processing

• Familiarity with Siscomex, Mercante/Siscarga, and Brazilian RFB processes

• Proficiency in MS Office and shipping/ERP tools

• English – Fluent; Portuguese - Fluent

Work Environment & Specific Requirements

• Office-based role with potential port or terminal document runs

• Requires high accuracy, attention to detail, and deadline discipline

• May require extended working hours during vessel cut-offs or peak operational periods

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.

Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.

Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Tech Sourcer - Remote - Latin America
description:
Senior Tech Sourcer

Summary

We're looking for an experienced Tech Sourcer to join Kake's internal team and help build our sourcing function from the ground up. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing and executing sourcing strategies for technical roles, partnering closely with recruiters, and building strong talent pipelines. If you enjoy deep sourcing, proactive outreach, and shaping scalable processes, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with recruiters during role kick-offs to align on hiring needs, must-haves, dealbreakers, and sourcing strategy.
  • Own end-to-end technical sourcing for new roles, building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines.
  • Design and execute sourcing strategies using Boolean search, headhunting, talent mapping, and targeted company research.
  • Create tailored outreach messages to attract and engage high-quality technical candidates.
  • Conduct initial profile and pre-screening assessments, identifying fit, gaps, and potential risks early in the process.
  • Manage sourced candidates in the ATS, ensuring accurate tracking, stage updates, and smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates, supporting scheduling and follow-ups when needed.
  • Contribute to building sourcing processes, best practices, and documentation as the function scales.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sourcing or talent sourcing roles.
  • Strong experience sourcing for technical profiles across different stacks and seniority levels.
  • Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch using proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience helping to build or scale a sourcing function.
  • Familiarity with market mapping and talent intelligence.
  • Experience working closely with recruiters in high-growth environments.

Other Traits

  • Proactive and curious, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement in sourcing strategies and processes.

Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world's most innovative companies, and we've built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We're proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we're the destination.The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Product Owner - Wholesale Banking
